name: Estelle Ceulemans - § 18 - Am 7
title: REPORT with recommendations to the Commission on psychosocial risk, stress and mental health at work
part_text: 18. Considers that priority should be given to the effective implementation and enforcement of the existing Union occupational safety and health framework; considers that additional Union legislation should only be envisaged where clear regulatory gaps cannot be effectively addressed by Member States, in full respect of the principles of subsidiarity and proportionality and without imposing disproportionate administrative or financial burdens, in particular on SMEs and micro-enterprises;
